notes: Royal Canin publishes no price list, so the sample is the connector's own snapshot of their HK webshop, read under the clinic's account on 2026-08-27 and split by the channel Royal Canin files each product under. This half is the veterinary range (162 products, VHN/VD). The two rows below are the pair that matters commercially: the same price column means one bag on one row and a twelve-pouch case on the next, and only the row's own nav_uom says which. A delimited row has no page of its own — page_number 1 is the single snapshot unit.

source.extraction_method: connector snapshot (Algolia product index, customer group 879)

expected_semantics.reason: nav_uom says INNER BOX, so HK$105 buys the case, not a pouch. The name prints the pack (85G X 12) and navision_weight agrees (12 x 85 g = 1.02 kg), so twelve is evidenced rather than assumed — and units_per_pack is deliberately NOT forced to 1, which is what keeps a case from being read as a single item.
